Rustlings 6.5.0 src/exercise.rs characterization baseline
resolved commit: 2af9e89ba536fad01aa828b06e0ac2174bad0f6d
source: https://github.com/rust-lang/rustlings/blob/2af9e89ba536fad01aa828b06e0ac2174bad0f6d/src/exercise.rs

run order: build -> optional test -> clippy -> binary
build failure -> failure without later stages
test failure -> binary output -> failure
clippy always uses --profile test
strict clippy -> --profile test -- -D warnings
clippy failure still runs the binary; pass requires both clippy and binary success
nonzero binary exit remains a learner failure and emits an explanatory output line
